# CANDIDATE: ATR_VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A contraction of ATR to half its recent average signals low volatility; a subsequent breakout of the 20-bar range with above-average volume captures the ensuing expansion move. This aims to exploit volatility compression-breakout cycles that occur during low-moderate VIX regimes (12-20) and late morning to early afternoon (09:30-13:00 EST) when institutional participation drives directional moves.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: If ATR(14) < 0.5 × average(ATR(14),20) AND the high exceeds the highest high of the prior 20 bars AND volume > 1.2 × average(volume,20), go long at close; else if low < lowest low of prior 20 bars AND volume > 1.2 × average(volume,20), go short at close.  
Exit shape: Chart stop at the opposite extreme of the 20-bar range (lowest low for longs, highest high for shorts); initial target at 2R, with a runner trailing 15% off the highest‑high (long) or lowest‑low (short).  
Regime hint: Effective when VIX is between 12‑20 (low‑moderate volatility) and during the late morning to early afternoon (09:30‑13:00 EST) when compression‑breakout cycles are common.
